svg.title: The Naryn corridor
svg.desc: The ISEZ corridor from Talas through the Otmek Tunnel and over the Fergana Gateway to the Toktogul basin and the Lower Naryn: the Fergana Mountain Transit Highway (State Route 1), Toktogul District (the State Route 1 corridor from the Otmek Tunnel over the Ala-Bel and the Toktogul basin with the town, reservoir and dam, in the ISEZ since the 2009 protocol), and Lower Naryn District below the dam: Kara-Köl, the narrow corridor down the Naryn gorge with the downstream cascade, the flats at Iyık Janyl and Tash-Kömür, and the lowland farm belt of the northern Fergana rim round Bazar-Korgon down to the Uzbek frontier. Line, districts, road and heights: Kartalar map data. Relief: SRTM via the AWS Terrain Tiles (public domain). Base map: Natural Earth (public domain). Chu, Talas and Chatkal rivers © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
